How to install tape in hair extensions:

Step 1: Use the comb to pick up a thin slice of natural hair as wide as your tape extensions.

Step 2: Press the natural hair downward into the tape leaving 1 inch-2 inch space between the scalp and the extension.

Step 3: Peel away the second tape and place this piece directly over the first, sandwiching the natural hair in between and seal the tape with a flat iron for maximum adherence.

Step 4: Repeat for full head

If you are unsure about doing this process at home, we HIGHLY recommend you go to a professional stylist who has been trained to do tape in hair extensions.

Tips for hair caring:

① Try to wash your hair as infrequently as possible, every 2 or 3 days is recommended.

② Use sulfate-free shampoo because sulfate can damage your extensions.

③ Avoid using too many hair products, because that can also cause tangling and matting.

④ Use acidic shampoo for light color hair extensions can help avoid matting.

Note: Natural growing hair have layers because they do not grow at the same speed. The hair extensions also have layers, hair at the bottom would be thinner than hair at the upper part. This can make the whole look more natural.

description:
Tips to Remember
1. Use a friend. If you don't have any friends, you can use two mirrors to see the back of your head and do it yourself.
2. Be aware of placement. Avoid putting your extensions too close to the edge of your scalp (by your face and stuff), or putting them too high up towards your part!
3. Sticky to sticky. Make sure the sticky bits from the top and bottom extension are touching each other, for maximum adherence.
Wearing Instruction
1. Wash Your Hair and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section (Bottom to Top)
Start your first row an inch or two up from the bottom of your scalp. Use a comb to part your hair evenly. Pull the top half up and secure it, leaving the bottom half hanging down. 3. Gather a *Very* Thin Section of Your Hair
Use your comb to get a nice even section which as wide as one of your extension wefts.This section of hair is going to be sandwiched between two extensions. Make sure the adhesive "tape" on the top extension touches that of the bottom extension so that the two stick together.
4. Attach Extension
A good way to tell if your section is thin enough is attach the bottom extension in place, flush against your scalp. Use your comb to carefully pull some of your hair off of the tape. When you can feel the sticky, attach the top extension. Press the top and bottom wefts together firmly for about 20 seconds to make sure that they're stuck to each other.
5. Cut and Style
If you have a short blunt cut, you're going to have to do some trimming.
Styling Pro Tip:
If you have a short blunt haircut, some of your hair may stick out from underneath your bottom layer of extensions, totally giving you away. Take all of these short hairs and bobby pin them to your scalp, so they won't be seen under your longest layer of extensions. If you want know more about the hair, please contact us before order.

HOW TO WASH THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Comb your hair with a brush that has soft bristles or a comb with wire pin just before you wash it.This releases any tangles.It is best not to comb from top to ends one time if the hair is a curly style.
2.Wet your hair with lukewarm water.Hot water may be more comfortable,but it deteriorates the synthetic hair fibers and shortens the extensions' lifespan.Do not attempt to brush your synthetic hair extensions when they are wet.
3.Lather the hair and extensions with a mild shampoo without a bunch of unpronounceable chemicals as ingredients.All-natural is best.
4.Rinse the shampoo out of hair extensions.Use a hair conditioner that is very oily,like a deep conditioning treatment.Rinse off 90% but leave just a little in,to prevent tangling.

HOW TO APPLY THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Divide your hair into two sections.If your hair is very thin,Use a comb to gently tease the lower half of your hair in one-inch sections.This will help keep the extensions securely in place.
2.Open the clips on your extensions.Align the tops of the hair extensions with the horizontal part you have made,and gently push down to snap the clips into place.3.Release the top section of your hair.Gently tousle to blend your natural hair with the clip-on extensions.
4.Finish your hair style. Tease your hair at the roots and brush out the top layer so that it is smooth. Your clip-in extensions should be completely blended so that you cannot see them at the roots of your locks.

1.Comb your hair with a brush that has soft bristles or a comb with wire pin just before you wash it. This releases any tangles. It is best not to comb from top to ends one time if the hair is a curly style.

description:
These thin, narrow, lightweight, heat resistant polyester fiber strands can be washed, cut, curled, flat ironed or blow dried.

Like with any tinsel they can slide out of your hair if you don’t tie them well enough or if your hair is super fine. It does take a bit of practice but once mastered you won’t regret the time spent. These are super fun to wear!

If you can tie a knot, you can install this hair tinsel! With care, tinsel hair can last several weeks, even through washing, drying, and flat ironing. For long lasting effect use 3 - 5 strands of hair when attaching tinsel and do 2 or 3 knots with the hair and the hair tinsel. It might be easier if the hair is damp. Adding a little bit of dry shampoo to the root can add a texture to hair and prevent tinsel sliding down.

How to apply:
Step 1. Create a slip knot: Select a strand of hair tinsel and create a small loop. Pull the end of the tinsel through the loop completely.
Step 2. Tie the tinsel and hair together:
For fine hair select 3 or 4 hairs (for thicker hair-1 or2)
Slide slip knot onto the hair. Pull tinsel and hair side to side direction, making sure the knot is close to the hair shaft. Tie the hairs and the tinsel together in a knot. Once the knot is at the base of the hair pull it tight. Now you can drop the hair
Pull the ends of tinsels in opposite directions until knot is secure. Try pulling tinsel holding it closer to the knot (to prevent tinsel stretching and breaking)
Step 3: Tie few more knots with the tinsel only. The finished knot should be at the base of hair, small and flattened into the hair.

description:
Tips to Remember
1. Use a friend. If you don't have any friends, you can use two mirrors to see the back of your head and do it yourself.
2. Be aware of placement. Avoid putting your extensions too close to the edge of your scalp (by your face and stuff), or putting them too high up towards your part!
3. Sticky to sticky. Make sure the sticky bits from the top and bottom extension are touching each other, for maximum adherence.
Wearing Instruction
1. Wash Your Hair and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section (Bottom to Top)
Start your first row an inch or two up from the bottom of your scalp. Use a comb to part your hair evenly. Pull the top half up and secure it, leaving the bottom half hanging down. 3. Gather a *Very* Thin Section of Your Hair
Use your comb to get a nice even section which as wide as one of your extension wefts.This section of hair is going to be sandwiched between two extensions. Make sure the adhesive "tape" on the top extension touches that of the bottom extension so that the two stick together.
4. Attach Extension
A good way to tell if your section is thin enough is attach the bottom extension in place, flush against your scalp. Use your comb to carefully pull some of your hair off of the tape. When you can feel the sticky, attach the top extension. Press the top and bottom wefts together firmly for about 20 seconds to make sure that they're stuck to each other.
5. Cut and Style
If you have a short blunt cut, you're going to have to do some trimming.
Styling Pro Tip:
If you have a short blunt haircut, some of your hair may stick out from underneath your bottom layer of extensions, totally giving you away. Take all of these short hairs and bobby pin them to your scalp, so they won't be seen under your longest layer of extensions. If you want know more about the hair, please contact us before order.

Tips to Remember
1. Use a friend. If you don't have any friends, you can use two mirrors to see the back of your head and do it yourself.
2. Be aware of placement. Avoid putting your extensions too close to the edge of your scalp (by your face and stuff), or putting them too high up towards your part!
3. Sticky to sticky. Make sure the sticky bits from the top and bottom extension are touching each other, for maximum adherence.
Wearing Instruction
1. Wash Your Hair and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section (Bottom to Top)
Start your first row an inch or two up from the bottom of your scalp. Use a comb to part your hair evenly. Pull the top half up and secure it, leaving the bottom half hanging down. 3. Gather a *Very* Thin Section of Your Hair
Use your comb to get a nice even section which as wide as one of your extension wefts.This section of hair is going to be sandwiched between two extensions. Make sure the adhesive "tape" on the top extension touches that of the bottom extension so that the two stick together.
4. Attach Extension
A good way to tell if your section is thin enough is attach the bottom extension in place, flush against your scalp. Use your comb to carefully pull some of your hair off of the tape. When you can feel the sticky, attach the top extension. Press the top and bottom wefts together firmly for about 20 seconds to make sure that they're stuck to each other.
5. Cut and Style
If you have a short blunt cut, you're going to have to do some trimming.
Styling Pro Tip:
If you have a short blunt haircut, some of your hair may stick out from underneath your bottom layer of extensions, totally giving you away. Take all of these short hairs and bobby pin them to your scalp, so they won't be seen under your longest layer of extensions. If you want know more about the hair, please contact us before order.

description:
Want to make your hair sparkle? In La Bella, we show you how to apply hair tinsel to your strands--a fun, festive look that's been seen on celebrities like Beyonce on the red carpet. Just grab a buddy, the hair tinsel strips and take turns blinging out each other's hair.

This glamorous look is so easy and affordable, anyone can do it.

Here's how:

1. First, select a single strand of hair tinsel and fold it in half forming a loop.

2. Next, select 2-3 strands of hair at your desired location (more if you have thin hair).

3. Tie a slip knot around the selected hairs by wrapping the loop around the hairs and pulling the ends of the hair tinsel through the loop. Slide the knot to the scalp.

4. Tie a square knot with the selected hairs and the hair tinsel (L over R, then R over L). Make sure the knot is touching the scalp.

5. If the knot still slides, tie another square knot.

6. That's it! Enjoy your new head turning look and soak up all the compliments!

Warm tips:

Style your hair as normal but be careful if using a comb not to pull directly on the knot.

For longer wear or for thin hair, you can add some lash glue to dot the knot.

HOW TO WASH THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Comb your hair with a brush that has soft bristles or a comb with wire pin just before you wash it. This releases any tangles. It is best not to comb from top to ends one time if the hair is a curly style.
2.Wet your hair with lukewarm water. Hot water may be more comfortable, but it deteriorates the synthetic hair fibers and shortens the extensions' lifespan.Do not attempt to brush your synthetic hair extensions when they are wet.
3.Lather the hair and extensions with a mild shampoo without a bunch of unpronounceable chemicals as ingredients. All-natural is best.
4.Rinse the shampoo out of hair extensions. Use a hair conditioner that is very oily, like a deep conditioning treatment. Rinse off 90% but leave just a little in, to prevent tangling.
5.Towel-dry your hair as best you can and then allow nature to finish the process. Do not blow dry, this will cause a lot of useless tangles that will ruin your extensions.

HOW TO APPLY THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Divide your hair into two sections. If your hair is very thin, Use a comb to gently tease the lower half of your hair in one-inch sections. This will help keep the extensions securely in place.
2.Open the clips on your extensions. Align the tops of the hair extensions with the horizontal part you have made, and gently push down to snap the clips into place.
3.Release the top section of your hair. Gently tousle to blend your natural hair with the clip-on extensions.
4.Finish your hair style. Tease your hair at the roots and brush out the top layer so that it is smooth. Your clip-in extensions should be completely blended so that you cannot see them at the roots of your locks.

description:
QUEEN HAIR BRAZILIAN WEAVE MAINTENANCE
Good maintenance of your hair is essential - it deteiTnines how long it will last. Remy hair and chemically stripped hair will tangle slightly less than non-Remy hair, but it is important to note that all hair will tangle to some degree. Here's how to manage your Brazilian weave:
1.Brush your hair twice a day, starting at the tips. When brushing, hold your hair in the middle. Gently and slowly brush out the tangles at the ends, working your way up to the top of your head. Don't brush vigorously as this will cause the hair to shed (and curly hair to lose its curl). A detangling brush or wide-toothed comb may be used to brush out severe tangles.
2.Always brush your hair before washing it.
3.Gently wash your hair in warm water with sulphate-free shampoo, taking care not to scrunch the hair as this will cause tangling. If you have used a lot of product on your hair and it's not attached to your head, leave it to soak for 10 minutes.
4.Rinse your hair with warm water.
5.Apply sulphate-free conditioner, remembering not to scrunch the hair.
6.Rinse the conditioner out thoroughly under warm water.
7.We recommend air drying your hair. Gently pat your hair with a dry towel and leave it to stand.
If you use a blow dryer, always use a medium heat setting.
8.Spray leave-in conditioner and brush gently. Don't tug on the hair as it may loosen the weft and cause shedding.
9.Deep condition the hair regularly to maintain its optimal condition. If heating tools arc used fi equently, do this at least once a month. If the hair has been coloured or chemically treated, increase this to at least twice a month.
10.The best way to maintain the health of your weave is to treat it like your own hair. Natural oils, deep treatment and crcmcs arc some of the best ways to keep it from becoming dry or brittle.

description:
HOW TO WASH THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Comb your hair with a brush that has soft bristles or a comb with wire pin just before you wash it. This releases any tangles. It is best not to comb from top to ends one time if the hair is a curly style.
2.Wet your hair with lukewarm water. Hot water may be more comfortable, but it deteriorates the synthetic hair fibers and shortens the extensions' lifespan.Do not attempt to brush your synthetic hair extensions when they are wet.
3.Lather the hair and extensions with a mild shampoo without a bunch of unpronounceable chemicals as ingredients. All-natural is best.
4.Rinse the shampoo out of hair extensions. Use a hair conditioner that is very oily, like a deep conditioning treatment. Rinse off 90% but leave just a little in, to prevent tangling.
5.Towel-dry your hair as best you can and then allow nature to finish the process. Do not blow dry, this will cause a lot of useless tangles that will ruin your extensions.

HOW TO APPLY THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Divide your hair into two sections. If your hair is very thin, Use a comb to gently tease the lower half of your hair in one-inch sections. This will help keep the extensions securely in place.
2.Open the clips on your extensions. Align the tops of the hair extensions with the horizontal part you have made, and gently push down to snap the clips into place.
3.Release the top section of your hair. Gently tousle to blend your natural hair with the clip-on extensions.
4.Finish your hair style. Tease your hair at the roots and brush out the top layer so that it is smooth. Your clip-in extensions should be completely blended so that you cannot see them at the roots of your locks.

How to install tape in hair extensions:

1. Make sure they were put in correctly.
2. Do NOT color your hair the same day you get tape-ins.
3. No alcohol or oil based products should be used while wearing tape extensions, these will break tape adhesive down much faster. Use special hair extension hair care products to ensure long lasting tape extensions.

How to install tape in hair extensions:

Step 1: Use the comb to pick up a thin slice of natural hair as wide as your tape extensions.

Step 2: Press the natural hair downward into the tape leaving 1 inch-2 inch space between the scalp and the extension.

Step 3: Peel away the second tape and place this piece directly over the first, sandwiching the natural hair in between and seal the tape with a flat iron for maximum adherence.

Step 4: Repeat for full head

If you are unsure about doing this process at home, we HIGHLY recommend you go to a professional stylist who has been trained to do tape in hair extensions.

Tips for hair caring:

① Try to wash your hair as infrequently as possible, every 2 or 3 days is recommended.

② Use sulfate-free shampoo because sulfate can damage your extensions.

③ Avoid using too many hair products, because that can also cause tangling and matting.

④ Use acidic shampoo for light color hair extensions can help avoid matting.

Note: Natural growing hair have layers because they do not grow at the same speed. The hair extensions also have layers, hair at the bottom would be thinner than hair at the upper part. This can make the whole look more natural.

Tips to Remember 1. Use a friend. If you don't have any friends, you can use two mirrors to see the back of your head and do it yourself.
2. Be aware of placement. Avoid putting your extensions too close to the edge of your scalp (by your face and stuff), or putting them too high up towards your part!
3. Sticky to sticky. Make sure the sticky bits from the top and bottom extension are touching each other, for maximum adherence.

Wearing Instruction
1. Wash Your Hair and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section (Bottom to Top)
Start your first row an inch or two up from the bottom of your scalp. Use a comb to part your hair evenly. Pull the top half up and secure it, leaving the bottom half hanging down.
3. Gather a *Very* Thin Section of Your Hair
Use your comb to get a nice even section which as wide as one of your extension wefts.This section of hair is going to be sandwiched between two extensions. Make sure the adhesive "tape" on the top extension touches that of the bottom extension so that the two stick together.
4. Attach Extension
A good way to tell if your section is thin enough is attach the bottom extension in place, flush against your scalp. Use your comb to carefully pull some of your hair off of the tape. When you can feel the sticky, attach the top extension. Press the top and bottom wefts together firmly for about 20 seconds to make sure that they're stuck to each other.
5. Cut and Style
If you have a short blunt cut, you're going to have to do some trimming.

Styling Pro Tip:
If you have a short blunt haircut, some of your hair may stick out from underneath your bottom layer of extensions, totally giving you away. Take all of these short hairs and bobby pin them to your scalp, so they won't be seen under your longest layer of extensions.

How To Attach
Step 1: Brush your own hair and your hairpiece through evenly to remove all knots.
Step 2: Take your hair from each ear and section off in a clear curved part across your head and secure with hairclip.
Step 3: Open all snap-lock clips.
Step 4: Place the middle clip in the center of your part just above the section line, and close the clip.
Step 5: Place one side clip into position along the part and close the clip.
Step 6: Place the second side clip into position and snap shut.
Step 7: Release own hair from hairclip and comb through.
Step 8: Enjoy how natural your 'NEW HAIR' looks and feels!

Care your Hair Extension
1) wash it by the most mild shampoo or one specially formulated for chemically treated hair, and clean in warm water as well. Please use the shampoo recommended by local professional hairdresser.
2) don't comb the wet hair after washing and drying naturally is best.
3) please straighten hair if hair extension is straight when it is wet ; please gel hair if it is wavy.
4) don't blow hair root too nearly by dryer; don't grasp hair root when washing.
5) don't cover hair extension under sun in a long time ; don't swim wearing hair extension.

Remove
Simply open the clip by gently pulling backwards until you hear the clip release. Then gently remove the section being careful not to pull your hair. It is suggested to move the placement of your sections slightly every couple of wearing. This will allow the clip to rest in a different area preventing too much stress on your hair.

The patch test is used to ensure your customer does not have any negative reactions to a particular tape or adhesive.
1.Place a small amount of adhesive/tape on an area of sensitive skin.
2.Put a band-aid over the adhesive/tape and send your customer home for the night.
3.Instruct them to remove the band-aid the following day and check for any reaction.

1. Use your index fingers or a comb to make a U shaped part on the back of your head that spans from ear to ear. This U shaped part is known as a "track". Snap open each clip on one of your wefts.

How to install tape in hair extensions:
Step 1: Use the comb to pick up a thin slice of natural hair as wide as your tape extensions.
Step 2: Press the natural hair downward into the tape leaving 1 inch-2 inch space between the scalp and the extension.
Step 3: Peel away the second tape and place this piece directly over the first, sandwiching the natural hair in between and seal the tape with a flat iron for maximum adherence.
Step 4: Repeat for full head
If you are unsure about doing this process at home, we HIGHLY recommend you go to a professional stylist who has been trained to do tape in hair extensions.

Tips to Remember:
1. Do not comb or brush the hair extensions while hair is wet. Never sleep with wet hair extensions.
2. Make sure that do not wash your hair at least 3 days after the application, otherwise it will cause slippage.
3. Every 4-6 weeks, your hair extensions will need to be reapplied to move the bonds closer to the scalp and to keep your hair healthy.
4. When using conditioner, condition from mid-shaft to ends only. Do not apply conditioner to your scalp when wearing tape in hair extensions

1.It’s important to prep your hair by washing, deep conditioning, and don’t forget a protein treatment your hair before the installation.

2.Wet your hair with lukewarm water.Hot water may be more comfortable,but it deteriorates the synthetic hair fibers and shortens the extensions' lifespan.Do not attempt to brush your synthetic hair extensions when they are wet.

CARE FOR YOUR HAIR EXTENSIONS

You’ve just spent hours with your hair stylist and now you have gorgeous, flowing extensions that blend in so well you would think it’s your own hair if you didn’t know any better. The color match is perfect, the length is envious and you couldn’t be happier. Now it’s time to care for this amazing investment you just made. Caring for hair extensions doesn’t have to be a huge chore; here are some tips for easy care to keep your extensions beautiful and ensure they last as long as possible.


IT’S ALL ABOUT BRUSHING

In order to keep your own natural hair looking its best you have to brush it and extensions aren’t any different. Brushing your hair and your extensions is an important part of daily upkeep that should not be overlooked.


WASH, WASH, WASH

Washing, like brushing, is a regular part of maintenance for your extensions. Make sure that your extensions aren’t tangled, do that by brushing your hair before you wash it. After you wash it, possibly with conditioner still in your hair, run a wide tooth comb through it to make sure it doesn’t tangle.


LET YOUR HAIR DRY NATURALLY

If you can allow your hair to dry without using a blow dryer your extensions will last a lot longer and look better. You also shouldn’t sleep on wet hair because you might cause your hair to tangle and in turn damage your extensions.

43. Finish your hair style. Tease your hair at the roots and brush out the top layer so that it is smooth. Your clip-in extensions should be completely blended so that you cannot see them at the roots of your locks.

The following is a general outline of how to maintain synthetic hair. Individual product may behave differently based on usage and style. Consult your stylist for specific instructions.

description:
HOW TO WASH THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Comb your hair with a brush that has soft bristles or a comb with wire pin just before you wash it. This releases any tangles. It is best not to comb from top to ends one time if the hair is a curly style.
2.Wet your hair with lukewarm water. Hot water may be more comfortable, but it deteriorates the synthetic hair fibers and shortens the extensions' lifespan.Do not attempt to brush your synthetic hair extensions when they are wet.
3.Lather the hair and extensions with a mild shampoo without a bunch of unpronounceable chemicals as ingredients. All-natural is best.
4.Rinse the shampoo out of hair extensions. Use a hair conditioner that is very oily, like a deep conditioning treatment. Rinse off 90% but leave just a little in, to prevent tangling.
5.Towel-dry your hair as best you can and then allow nature to finish the process. Do not blow dry, this will cause a lot of useless tangles that will ruin your extensions.

HOW TO APPLY THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Divide your hair into two sections. If your hair is very thin, Use a comb to gently tease the lower half of your hair in one-inch sections. This will help keep the extensions securely in place.
2.Open the clips on your extensions. Align the tops of the hair extensions with the horizontal part you have made, and gently push down to snap the clips into place.
3.Release the top section of your hair. Gently tousle to blend your natural hair with the clip-on extensions.
4.Finish your hair style. Tease your hair at the roots and brush out the top layer so that it is smooth. Your clip-in extensions should be completely blended so that you cannot see them at the roots of your locks.

1.Start sectioning your hair from bottom to top

4.Place hair connector tool under hair

Warm Tips
1.Hair section is not too large, otherwise, the hair will not pull through ring.

description:
HOW TO WASH THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Comb your hair with a brush that has soft bristles or a comb with wire pin just before you wash it. This releases any tangles. It is best not to comb from top to ends one time if the hair is a curly style.
2.Wet your hair with lukewarm water. Hot water may be more comfortable, but it deteriorates the synthetic hair fibers and shortens the extensions' lifespan.Do not attempt to brush your synthetic hair extensions when they are wet.
3.Lather the hair and extensions with a mild shampoo without a bunch of unpronounceable chemicals as ingredients. All-natural is best.
4.Rinse the shampoo out of hair extensions. Use a hair conditioner that is very oily, like a deep conditioning treatment. Rinse off 90% but leave just a little in, to prevent tangling.
5.Towel-dry your hair as best you can and then allow nature to finish the process. Do not blow dry, this will cause a lot of useless tangles that will ruin your extensions.

HOW TO APPLY THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Divide your hair into two sections. If your hair is very thin, Use a comb to gently tease the lower half of your hair in one-inch sections. This will help keep the extensions securely in place.
2.Open the clips on your extensions. Align the tops of the hair extensions with the horizontal part you have made, and gently push down to snap the clips into place.
3.Release the top section of your hair. Gently tousle to blend your natural hair with the clip-on extensions.
4.Finish your hair style. Tease your hair at the roots and brush out the top layer so that it is smooth. Your clip-in extensions should be completely blended so that you cannot see them at the roots of your locks.

Micro loop hair extensions
Micro link hair extensions are a method of strand by strand fusion that utilizes small attachment rings. It doesn't require any glue, heat, keratin bonding or sewing, there is no damage to your hair. Micro ring extensions are perfect in adding Thickness and length to your hair.

How many packs should I purchase?
Usually, 2-3 packs is enough for a full head, if you need to add both length and volume, we recommend 3-4 packs.1-2 packs to add highlight.

How to apply the micro loop ring hair extensions?
1.Wash and dry your hair completely before starting.
2.Section off your hair about an inch from the nape of your neck.
3.Take a strand of your own hair(Remember to take more hair, that could avoid the falling out problem), place it through the loop, and pull the bottom of the loop which lies under the bead.
4.Clamp the rings shut with pliers.(You have to clamped them tight enough to avoid them slide out. )
5.Leave another fingers width between each extension. With each new layer, you'll be building up the extensions.
Tip: If you are unsure about doing this process at home, we HIGHLY recommend you go to a professional stylist who has been trained to do micro loop hair extensions.
Please attention:
1. If you have very short hair, it will be harder to make the extensions invisible.

How to install tape in hair extensions:

Step 1: Use the comb to pick up a thin slice of natural hair as wide as your tape extensions.

① Try to wash your hair as infrequently as possible, every 2 or 3 days is recommended.

description:
HOW TO WASH THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Comb your hair with a brush that has soft bristles or a comb with wire pin just before you wash it.This releases any tangles.It is best not to comb from top to ends one time if the hair is a curly style.
2.Wet your hair with lukewarm water.Hot water may be more comfortable,but it deteriorates the synthetic hair fibers and shortens the extensions' lifespan.Do not attempt to brush your synthetic hair extensions when they are wet.
3.Lather the hair and extensions with a mild shampoo without a bunch of unpronounceable chemicals as ingredients.All-natural is best.
4.Rinse the shampoo out of hair extensions.Use a hair conditioner that is very oily,like a deep conditioning treatment.Rinse off 90% but leave just a little in,to prevent tangling.
5.Towel-dry your hair as best you can and then allow nature to finish the process.Do not blow dry,this will cause a lot of useless tangles that will ruin your extensions.

HOW TO APPLY THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Divide your hair into two sections.If your hair is very thin,Use a comb to gently tease the lower half of your hair in one-inch sections.This will help keep the extensions securely in place.
2.Open the clips on your extensions.Align the tops of the hair extensions with the horizontal part you have made,and gently push down to snap the clips into place.3.Release the top section of your hair.Gently tousle to blend your natural hair with the clip-on extensions.
4.Finish your hair style. Tease your hair at the roots and brush out the top layer so that it is smooth. Your clip-in extensions should be completely blended so that you cannot see them at the roots of your locks.

description:
Tips to Remember 1. Use a friend. 
2. Be aware of placement.  Avoid putting your extensions too close to the edge of your scalp (by your face and stuff), or putting them too high up towards your part!
3. Sticky to sticky. Make sure the sticky bits from the top and bottom extension are touching each other, for maximum adherence.

Wearing Instruction
1. Wash Your Hair and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section (Bottom to Top)
Start your first row an inch or two up from the bottom of your scalp. Use a comb to part your hair evenly. Pull the top half up and secure it, leaving the bottom half hanging down.
3. Gather a *Very* Thin Section of Your Hair
Use your comb to get a nice even section which as wide as one of your extension wefts.This section of hair is going to be sandwiched between two extensions. Make sure the adhesive "tape" on the top extension touches that of the bottom extension so that the two stick together.
4. Attach Extension
A good way to tell if your section is thin enough is attach the bottom extension in place, flush against your scalp. Use your comb to carefully pull some of your hair off of the tape. When you can feel the sticky, attach the top extension. Press the top and bottom wefts together firmly for about 20 seconds to make sure that they're stuck to each other.
5. Cut and Style
If you have a short blunt cut, you're going to have to do some trimming.

Step 1: Use the comb to pick up a thin slice of natural hair as wide as your tape extensions.

Tips to Remember 1. Use a friend. 
2. Be aware of placement. Avoid putting your extensions too close to the edge of your scalp (by your face and stuff), or putting them too high up towards your part!
3. Sticky to sticky. Make sure the sticky bits from the top and bottom extension are touching each other, for maximum adherence.

Wearing Instruction
1. Wash Your Hair and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section (Bottom to Top)
Start your first row an inch or two up from the bottom of your scalp. Use a comb to part your hair evenly. Pull the top half up and secure it, leaving the bottom half hanging down.
3. Gather a *Very* Thin Section of Your Hair
Use your comb to get a nice even section which as wide as one of your extension wefts.This section of hair is going to be sandwiched between two extensions. Make sure the adhesive "tape" on the top extension touches that of the bottom extension so that the two stick together.
4. Attach Extension
A good way to tell if your section is thin enough is attach the bottom extension in place, flush against your scalp. Use your comb to carefully pull some of your hair off of the tape. When you can feel the sticky, attach the top extension. Press the top and bottom wefts together firmly for about 20 seconds to make sure that they're stuck to each other.
5. Cut and Style
If you have a short blunt cut, you're going to have to do some trimming.

Micro loop hair extensions are a type of hair extension attached by threading sections of natural hair through small loops to hold each extension securely in place. They are also known as micro ring hair extensions.

How to Apply
1. Wash and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section off your hair about an inch from the nape of your neck.
3. Take a strand of your own hair, place it through the loop, and pull the bottom of the loop which lies under the bead.
4. Clamp the rings shut with pliars. ( You have to clamped them tight enough to avoid them slide out. )
5. Leave another fingers width between each extension. With each new layer, you'll be building up the extensions.

How to Properly Maintain and Care for Micro-Ring Hair Extensions？
1. Avoid Swimming Pools
2. Brush Your Hair on a Regular Basis
3. Tie Your Hair Back While You Sleep

Our micro ring stick-in extensions made from natural hair from India are easy to fix into your own hair. A strand of your own hair is pulled through the micro ring using a needle or loop. The bonded end of the extension strand is put into the ring, which is pressed together with small tongs. It’s just as quick to remove the strands by pressing open the ring. When the extensions are removed, nothing is left on the hair. Please use silicon inserts with the rings so that the strands stay in place and don’t slip. To create more volume in your hair we recommend 100-150g of hair. For full hair extensions you will need 200-300g of extensions. You can straighten, curl and style the extensions like your own hair. Be aware that too much heat can damage your own hair and the extensions. Our natural hair extensions can be darkened but we advise against colouring them as it can impair the lifespan of the hair. Care: You can straighten, curl or style our hair extensions with curling tongs as you would your own hair. It’s important to select the right products and care for the extensions properly. There are many special care products for extensions (shampoos, conditioners, shine sprays etc). We recommend care products from the brand Just Beautiful Hair, which have been tried and tested on our extensions. If you’re not sure what care products to use, please contact us. Colouring: Our hair extensions are made from 100% natural hair and can be darkened. We don’t recommend colouring them as it can impair the lifespan of the extensions.

Tips to Remember
1. Use a friend.
2. Be aware of placement. Avoid putting your extensions too close to the edge of your scalp (by your face and stuff), or putting them too high up towards your part!
3. Sticky to sticky. Make sure the sticky bits from the top and bottom extension are touching each other, for maximum adherence.
Wearing Instruction
1. Wash Your Hair and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section (Bottom to Top)
Start your first row an inch or two up from the bottom of your scalp. Use a comb to part your hair evenly. Pull the top half up and secure it, leaving the bottom half hanging down. 3. Gather a *Very* Thin Section of Your Hair
Use your comb to get a nice even section which as wide as one of your extension wefts.This section of hair is going to be sandwiched between two extensions. Make sure the adhesive "tape" on the top extension touches that of the bottom extension so that the two stick together.
4. Attach Extension
Attach the bottom extension in place, flush against your scalp. Use your comb to carefully pull some of your hair off of the tape. When you can feel the sticky, attach the top extension. Press the top and bottom wefts together firmly for about 20 seconds to make sure that they're stuck to each other.
5. Cut and Style
If you have a short blunt cut, you're going to have to do some trimming.
Styling Pro Tip:
If you have a short blunt haircut, some of your hair may stick out from underneath your bottom layer of extensions, totally giving you away. Take all of these short hairs and bobby pin them to your scalp, so they won't be seen under your longest layer of extensions. If you want know more about the hair, please contact us before order.

Tips to Remember
1. Use a friend.
2. Be aware of placement. Avoid putting your extensions too close to the edge of your scalp (by your face and stuff), or putting them too high up towards your part!
3. Sticky to sticky. Make sure the sticky bits from the top and bottom extension are touching each other, for maximum adherence.
Wearing Instruction
1. Wash Your Hair and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section (Bottom to Top)
Start your first row an inch or two up from the bottom of your scalp. Use a comb to part your hair evenly. Pull the top half up and secure it, leaving the bottom half hanging down. 3. Gather a *Very* Thin Section of Your Hair
Use your comb to get a nice even section which as wide as one of your extension wefts.This section of hair is going to be sandwiched between two extensions. Make sure the adhesive "tape" on the top extension touches that of the bottom extension so that the two stick together.
4. Attach Extension
Attach the bottom extension in place, flush against your scalp. Use your comb to carefully pull some of your hair off of the tape. When you can feel the sticky, attach the top extension. Press the top and bottom wefts together firmly for about 20 seconds to make sure that they're stuck to each other.
5. Cut and Style
If you have a short blunt cut, you're going to have to do some trimming.
Styling Pro Tip:
If you have a short blunt haircut, some of your hair may stick out from underneath your bottom layer of extensions, totally giving you away. Take all of these short hairs and bobby pin them to your scalp, so they won't be seen under your longest layer of extensions. If you want know more about the hair, please contact us before order.

General Care for Synthetic Hair

The following is a general outline of how to maintain synthetic hair. Individual product may behave differently based on usage and style. Consult your stylist for specific instructions.

  • Always wash hair in cool water using mild shampoo and conditioner. Washing in hot water will damage fiber.

  • If hair gets frizzy, use sheen spray - then comb.

  • Use of heating iron or other heat appliances is not recommended.

PRODUCT INSTRUCTION

Part your hair into four sections - from front to nape of the neck and ear to ear.

This makes it easier to work a section at a time.

Use hair clips to hold each section in place and out of the way.

Beginning with a back section, divide out, about an inch of your hair.

You can make your dividing lines parallel from the center of your head.

Divide each 1 inch line into smaller sections.

These smaller parts are each going to be fitted with an extension.

Take one of the small portions of your hair, twist it and pass it through a loop that has a string and an attached micro ring.

Now take the pre-tipped hair extension and pass into the micro ring tube.

Slide the micro-ring close to your scalp and close it with the closer tool.

Once it's flattened, the hair extension becomes firmly attached to your own hair.

Follow the same setps with each portion of your hair until you have covered the areas you want.

description:
HOW TO WASH THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Comb your hair with a brush that has soft bristles or a comb with wire pin just before you wash it. This releases any tangles. It is best not to comb from top to ends one time if the hair is a curly style.
2.Wet your hair with lukewarm water. Hot water may be more comfortable, but it deteriorates the synthetic hair fibers and shortens the extensions' lifespan.Do not attempt to brush your synthetic hair extensions when they are wet.
3.Lather the hair and extensions with a mild shampoo without a bunch of unpronounceable chemicals as ingredients. All-natural is best.
4.Rinse the shampoo out of hair extensions. Use a hair conditioner that is very oily, like a deep conditioning treatment. Rinse off 90% but leave just a little in, to prevent tangling.
5.Towel-dry your hair as best you can and then allow nature to finish the process. Do not blow dry, this will cause a lot of useless tangles that will ruin your extensions.

HOW TO APPLY THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Divide your hair into two sections. If your hair is very thin, Use a comb to gently tease the lower half of your hair in one-inch sections. This will help keep the extensions securely in place.
2.Open the clips on your extensions. Align the tops of the hair extensions with the horizontal part you have made, and gently push down to snap the clips into place.
3.Release the top section of your hair. Gently tousle to blend your natural hair with the clip-on extensions.
4.Finish your hair style. Tease your hair at the roots and brush out the top layer so that it is smooth. Your clip-in extensions should be completely blended so that you cannot see them at the roots of your locks.

description:
HOW TO WASH THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Comb your hair with a brush that has soft bristles or a comb with wire pin just before you wash it. This releases any tangles. It is best not to comb from top to ends one time if the hair is a curly style.
2.Wet your hair with lukewarm water. Hot water may be more comfortable, but it deteriorates the synthetic hair fibers and shortens the extensions' lifespan.Do not attempt to brush your synthetic hair extensions when they are wet.
3.Lather the hair and extensions with a mild shampoo without a bunch of unpronounceable chemicals as ingredients. All-natural is best.
4.Rinse the shampoo out of hair extensions. Use a hair conditioner that is very oily, like a deep conditioning treatment. Rinse off 90% but leave just a little in, to prevent tangling.
5.Towel-dry your hair as best you can and then allow nature to finish the process. Do not blow dry, this will cause a lot of useless tangles that will ruin your extensions.

HOW TO APPLY THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Divide your hair into two sections. If your hair is very thin, Use a comb to gently tease the lower half of your hair in one-inch sections. This will help keep the extensions securely in place.
2.Open the clips on your extensions. Align the tops of the hair extensions with the horizontal part you have made, and gently push down to snap the clips into place.
3.Release the top section of your hair. Gently tousle to blend your natural hair with the clip-on extensions.
4.Finish your hair style. Tease your hair at the roots and brush out the top layer so that it is smooth. Your clip-in extensions should be completely blended so that you cannot see them at the roots of your locks.

How to install tape in hair extensions:
Step 1: Use the comb to pick up a thin slice of natural hair as wide as your tape extensions.
Step 2: Press the natural hair downward into the tape leaving 1 inch-2 inch space between the scalp and the extension.
Step 3: Peel away the second tape and place this piece directly over the first, sandwiching the natural hair in between and seal the tape with a flat iron for maximum adherence.
Step 4: Repeat for full head
If you are unsure about doing this process at home, we HIGHLY recommend you go to a professional stylist who has been trained to do tape in hair extensions.

1. Do not comb or brush the hair extensions while hair is wet. Never sleep with wet hair extensions.

3. Every 4-6 weeks, your hair extensions will need to be reapplied to move the bonds closer to the scalp and to keep your hair healthy.
4. When using conditioner, condition from mid-shaft to ends only. Do not apply conditioner to your scalp when wearing tape in hair extensions

How to care
1. Brush before bed and before washing to ensure there are no natural occurring tangles caused by wind or friction.Do not brush wet hair as that is when hair follicles are at their most vulnerable.
2. Use an Organic and sulfate free shampoo.Sulfate strips hair of natural oils, as there is no direct supply of nutrients from your scalp into the extension strands, its vital that you use a no sulfate shampoo to avoid drying the hair out.

How to Wash & Condition

1. Avoid washing your hair for 72 hours after putting in your extensions.
2. Never use any hair products containing oil, alcohol or ethanol, because they can damage your extensions and wear down the adhesive on the tape.
You’ll want to use sulfate free shampoo and conditioner. When you shampoo your hair, tilt your head back and gently massage from the top of your head downwards, making sure not to pull on your hair too much or scrub too hard.
3. When applying conditioner, avoiding the root area of your extensions and use it only from mid-shaft to the ends of your hair.

Tips to Remember:
Do not comb or brush the hair extensions while hair is wet. Never sleep with wet hair extensions.

CARE FOR YOUR HAIR EXTENSIONS

You’ve just spent hours with your hair stylist and now you have gorgeous, flowing extensions that blend in so well you would think it’s your own hair if you didn’t know any better. The color match is perfect, the length is envious and you couldn’t be happier. Now it’s time to care for this amazing investment you just made. Caring for hair extensions doesn’t have to be a huge chore; here are some tips for easy care to keep your extensions beautiful and ensure they last as long as possible.


IT’S ALL ABOUT BRUSHING

In order to keep your own natural hair looking its best you have to brush it and extensions aren’t any different. Brushing your hair and your extensions is an important part of daily upkeep that should not be overlooked.


WASH, WASH, WASH

Washing, like brushing, is a regular part of maintenance for your extensions. Make sure that your extensions aren’t tangled, do that by brushing your hair before you wash it. After you wash it, possibly with conditioner still in your hair, run a wide tooth comb through it to make sure it doesn’t tangle.


LET YOUR HAIR DRY NATURALLY

If you can allow your hair to dry without using a blow dryer your extensions will last a lot longer and look better. You also shouldn’t sleep on wet hair because you might cause your hair to tangle and in turn damage your extensions.

HOW TO WASH THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Comb your hair with a brush that has soft bristles or a comb with wire pin just before you wash it.This releases any tangles.It is best not to comb from top to ends one time if the hair is a curly style.
2.Wet your hair with lukewarm water.Hot water may be more comfortable,but it deteriorates the synthetic hair fibers and shortens the extensions' lifespan.Do not attempt to brush your synthetic hair extensions when they are wet.
3.Lather the hair and extensions with a mild shampoo without a bunch of unpronounceable chemicals as ingredients.All-natural is best.
4.Rinse the shampoo out of hair extensions.Use a hair conditioner that is very oily,like a deep conditioning treatment.Rinse off 90% but leave just a little in,to prevent tangling.
5.Towel-dry your hair as best you can and then allow nature to finish the process.Do not blow dry,this will cause a lot of useless tangles that will ruin your extensions.

HOW TO APPLY THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Divide your hair into two sections.If your hair is very thin,Use a comb to gently tease the lower half of your hair in one-inch sections.This will help keep the extensions securely in place.
2.Open the clips on your extensions.Align the tops of the hair extensions with the horizontal part you have made,and gently push down to snap the clips into place.3.Release the top section of your hair.Gently tousle to blend your natural hair with the clip-on extensions.
4.Finish your hair style. Tease your hair at the roots and brush out the top layer so that it is smooth. Your clip-in extensions should be completely blended so that you cannot see them at the roots of your locks.

How to care

Brush before bed and before washing to ensure there are no natural occurring tangles caused by wind or friction.Do not brush wet hair as that is when hair follicles are at their most vulnerable.
Use an Organic and sulfate free shampoo.Sulfate strips hair of natural oils, as there is no direct supply of nutrients from your scalp into the extension strands, its vital that you use a no sulfate shampoo to avoid drying the hair out.

How to Wash & Condition

Avoid washing your hair for 72 hours after putting in your extensions.
Never use any hair products containing oil, alcohol or ethanol, because they can damage your extensions and wear down the adhesive on the tape.
You’ll want to use sulfate free shampoo and conditioner. When you shampoo your hair, tilt your head back and gently massage from the top of your head downwards, making sure not to pull on your hair too much or scrub too hard.
When applying conditioner, avoiding the root area of your extensions and use it only from mid-shaft to the ends of your hair.

Tips to Remember:

Do not comb or brush the hair extensions while hair is wet. Never sleep with wet hair extensions.

How to install tape in hair extensions:
Step 1: Use the comb to pick up a thin slice of natural hair as wide as your tape extensions.
Step 2: Press the natural hair downward into the tape leaving 1 inch-2 inch space between the scalp and the extension.
Step 3: Peel away the second tape and place this piece directly over the first, sandwiching the natural hair in between and seal the tape with a flat iron for maximum adherence.

How to make your tape-ins more secure:
1. Make sure they were put in correctly.
2. Do NOT color your hair the same day you get tape-ins.
3. No alcohol or oil based products should be used while wearing tape extensions, these will break tape adhesive down much faster. Use special hair extension hair care products to ensure long lasting tape extensions.
4. If you have naturally oily hair, tape extensions won't hold as long and you will need to replace your tape extensions more frequently - every 6 weeks to so. Try using oil control shampoo.

Tips to Remember
1. Use a friend.
2. Be aware of placement. Avoid putting your extensions too close to the edge of your scalp (by your face and stuff), or putting them too high up towards your part!
3. Sticky to sticky. Make sure the sticky bits from the top and bottom extension are touching each other, for maximum adherence.
Wearing Instruction
1. Wash Your Hair and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section (Bottom to Top)
Start your first row an inch or two up from the bottom of your scalp. Use a comb to part your hair evenly. Pull the top half up and secure it, leaving the bottom half hanging down. 3. Gather a *Very* Thin Section of Your Hair
Use your comb to get a nice even section which as wide as one of your extension wefts.This section of hair is going to be sandwiched between two extensions. Make sure the adhesive "tape" on the top extension touches that of the bottom extension so that the two stick together.
4. Attach Extension
Attach the bottom extension in place, flush against your scalp. Use your comb to carefully pull some of your hair off of the tape. When you can feel the sticky, attach the top extension. Press the top and bottom wefts together firmly for about 20 seconds to make sure that they're stuck to each other.
5. Cut and Style
If you have a short blunt cut, you're going to have to do some trimming.
Styling Pro Tip:
If you have a short blunt haircut, some of your hair may stick out from underneath your bottom layer of extensions, totally giving you away. Take all of these short hairs and bobby pin them to your scalp, so they won't be seen under your longest layer of extensions. If you want know more about the hair, please contact us before order.

A. Treat the hair as if it is your own. but never use hot tools too often as you could dry the hair and it will not last as long.

HOW TO WASH THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Comb your hair with a brush that has soft bristles or a comb with wire pin just before you wash it.This releases any tangles.It is best not to comb from top to ends one time if the hair is a curly style.
2.Wet your hair with lukewarm water.Hot water may be more comfortable,but it deteriorates the synthetic hair fibers and shortens the extensions' lifespan.Do not attempt to brush your synthetic hair extensions when they are wet.
3.Lather the hair and extensions with a mild shampoo without a bunch of unpronounceable chemicals as ingredients.All-natural is best.
4.Rinse the shampoo out of hair extensions.Use a hair conditioner that is very oily,like a deep conditioning treatment.Rinse off 90% but leave just a little in,to prevent tangling.
5.Towel-dry your hair as best you can and then allow nature to finish the process.Do not blow dry,this will cause a lot of useless tangles that will ruin your extensions.

HOW TO APPLY THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Divide your hair into two sections.If your hair is very thin,Use a comb to gently tease the lower half of your hair in one-inch sections.This will help keep the extensions securely in place.
2.Open the clips on your extensions.Align the tops of the hair extensions with the horizontal part you have made,and gently push down to snap the clips into place.3.Release the top section of your hair.Gently tousle to blend your natural hair with the clip-on extensions.
4.Finish your hair style. Tease your hair at the roots and brush out the top layer so that it is smooth. Your clip-in extensions should be completely blended so that you cannot see them at the roots of your locks.

Step 3:On the glue-side of the weft, press along the part with about ¼ inch from the roots and then you can press your fingers all along to the weft. Hold for about 30 seconds for the glue to dry.
Step 4:Unclip your hair and then create another horizontal part with about 0.5 inch above the first part.Repeat step 2 to 4 until you reach the crown of your head (top of the head).
Step 5:On both sides of the ear, create horizontal part about 0.5 inch and cut weft a little bit smaller than the horizontal part.Repeat the process until it reaches your temple.
If you are unsure about doing this process at home,we recommend you could go to Salon.

description:
HOW TO WASH THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Comb your hair with a brush that has soft bristles or a comb with wire pin just before you wash it. This releases any tangles. It is best not to comb from top to ends one time if the hair is a curly style.
2.Wet your hair with lukewarm water. Hot water may be more comfortable, but it deteriorates the synthetic hair fibers and shortens the extensions' lifespan.Do not attempt to brush your synthetic hair extensions when they are wet.
3.Lather the hair and extensions with a mild shampoo without a bunch of unpronounceable chemicals as ingredients. All-natural is best.
4.Rinse the shampoo out of hair extensions. Use a hair conditioner that is very oily, like a deep conditioning treatment. Rinse off 90% but leave just a little in, to prevent tangling.
5.Towel-dry your hair as best you can and then allow nature to finish the process. Do not blow dry, this will cause a lot of useless tangles that will ruin your extensions.

HOW TO APPLY THE HAIR EXTENSIONS
1.Divide your hair into two sections. If your hair is very thin, Use a comb to gently tease the lower half of your hair in one-inch sections. This will help keep the extensions securely in place.
2.Open the clips on your extensions. Align the tops of the hair extensions with the horizontal part you have made, and gently push down to snap the clips into place.
3.Release the top section of your hair. Gently tousle to blend your natural hair with the clip-on extensions.
4.Finish your hair style. Tease your hair at the roots and brush out the top layer so that it is smooth. Your clip-in extensions should be completely blended so that you cannot see them at the roots of your locks.

Tips to Remember

1. Use a friend. If you don't have any friends, you can use two mirrors to see the back of your head and do it yourself.
2. Be aware of placement. Avoid putting your extensions too close to the edge of your scalp (by your face and stuff), or putting them too high up towards your part!
3. Sticky to sticky. Make sure the sticky bits from the top and bottom extension are touching each other, for maximum adherence.


Wearing Instruction

1. Wash Your Hair and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section (Bottom to Top) Start your first row an inch or two up from the bottom of your scalp. Use a comb to part your hair evenly. Pull the top half up and secure it, leaving the bottom half hanging down.
3. Gather a *Very* Thin Section of Your Hair Use your comb to get a nice even section which as wide as one of your extension wefts.This section of hair is going to be sandwiched between two extensions. Make sure the adhesive "tape" on the top extension touches that of the bottom extension so that the two stick together.
4. Attach Extension A good way to tell if your section is thin enough is attach the bottom extension in place, flush against your scalp. Use your comb to carefully pull some of your hair off of the tape. When you can feel the sticky, attach the top extension. Press the top and bottom wefts together firmly for about 20 seconds to make sure that they're stuck to each other.
5. Cut and Style If you have a short blunt cut, you're going to have to do some trimming.
Styling Pro Tip: If you have a short blunt haircut, some of your hair may stick out from underneath your bottom layer of extensions, totally giving you away.
Take all of these short hairs and bobby pin them to your scalp, so they won't be seen under your longest layer of extensions. If you want know more about the hair, please contact us before order.

description:
At Ty.Hermenlisa, we are committed to ensuring that every customer is satisfied. Your full satisfaction can be achieved by the following care tips. First and foremost, always check the hair extensions before installation to find if any problem with the hair
If you detect any problems, contact us immediately. If there are no problems with the hair within the first 2 weeks, it can be assumed that the hair is fine. If problems arise after 2 weeks, the problem does not lie in the hair or workmanship. But still feel free to contact us and we will try to help you resolve your situation

Hair care
1. Before and after use, remember to brush your synthetic hair kindly with your fingers or soft bristle brush. Make sure all knots and tangles are gone! Brush the hair from the ends and work your way up
2. Synthetic fiber should be washed as infrequently as possible
3. Carefully soak it with warm or cold water (never hot water)& conditioner for 5 minutes
4. Add synthetic safe shampoo and wash gently, rinse the synthetic hair thoroughly, from top to bottom
5. Dab gently with a towel to remove excess water, do not squeeze, rub or twist
6. While still wet, spray with a leave in conditioner that is specifically formulated for synthetic hair goods
7. To dry, lay the synthetic hair flat on a towel at room temperature
8. Never brush or comb through your synthetic hair while they are wet, when completely dry brush it through from the end up to the top
9. No styling is necessary. Curls and waves will bounce back into position when completely dry
10. Hair dryer, curling irons and other thermal tools should not be used on synthetic fiber as the heat can melt the fiber. For heat resistant fiber, do not use a heating tool that exceeds 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Keep setting between 250-275 degrees. Blow drying is also not recommended

description:
Tips to Remember
1. Use a friend. If you don't have any friends, you can use two mirrors to see the back of your head and do it yourself.
2. Be aware of placement. Avoid putting your extensions too close to the edge of your scalp (by your face and stuff), or putting them too high up towards your part!
3. Sticky to sticky. Make sure the sticky bits from the top and bottom extension are touching each other, for maximum adherence.
Wearing Instruction
1. Wash Your Hair and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section (Bottom to Top)
Start your first row an inch or two up from the bottom of your scalp. Use a comb to part your hair evenly. Pull the top half up and secure it, leaving the bottom half hanging down. 3. Gather a *Very* Thin Section of Your Hair
Use your comb to get a nice even section which as wide as one of your extension wefts.This section of hair is going to be sandwiched between two extensions. Make sure the adhesive "tape" on the top extension touches that of the bottom extension so that the two stick together.
4. Attach Extension
A good way to tell if your section is thin enough is attach the bottom extension in place, flush against your scalp. Use your comb to carefully pull some of your hair off of the tape. When you can feel the sticky, attach the top extension. Press the top and bottom wefts together firmly for about 20 seconds to make sure that they're stuck to each other.
5. Cut and Style
If you have a short blunt cut, you're going to have to do some trimming.
Styling Pro Tip:
If you have a short blunt haircut, some of your hair may stick out from underneath your bottom layer of extensions, totally giving you away. Take all of these short hairs and bobby pin them to your scalp, so they won't be seen under your longest layer of extensions. If you want know more about the hair, please contact us before order.

Tips to Remember 1. Use a friend. 
2. Be aware of placement.  Avoid putting your extensions too close to the edge of your scalp (by your face and stuff), or putting them too high up towards your part!
3. Sticky to sticky. Make sure the sticky bits from the top and bottom extension are touching each other, for maximum adherence.

Wearing Instruction
1. Wash Your Hair and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section (Bottom to Top)
Start your first row an inch or two up from the bottom of your scalp. Use a comb to part your hair evenly. Pull the top half up and secure it, leaving the bottom half hanging down.
3. Gather a *Very* Thin Section of Your Hair
Use your comb to get a nice even section which as wide as one of your extension wefts.This section of hair is going to be sandwiched between two extensions. Make sure the adhesive "tape" on the top extension touches that of the bottom extension so that the two stick together.
4. Attach Extension
A good way to tell if your section is thin enough is attach the bottom extension in place, flush against your scalp. Use your comb to carefully pull some of your hair off of the tape. When you can feel the sticky, attach the top extension. Press the top and bottom wefts together firmly for about 20 seconds to make sure that they're stuck to each other.
5. Cut and Style
If you have a short blunt cut, you're going to have to do some trimming.

Tips to Remember
1. Use a friend.
2. Be aware of placement. Avoid putting your extensions too close to the edge of your scalp (by your face and stuff), or putting them too high up towards your part!

Wearing Instruction
1. Wash Your Hair and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section (Bottom to Top)
Start your first row an inch or two up from the bottom of your scalp. Use a comb to part your hair evenly. Pull the top half up and secure it, leaving the bottom half hanging down. 3. Gather a *Very* Thin Section of Your Hair
Use your comb to get a nice even section which as wide as one of your extension wefts.This section of hair is going to be sandwiched between two extensions. Make sure the adhesive "tape" on the top extension touches that of the bottom extension so that the two stick together.
4. Attach Extension
Attach the bottom extension in place, flush against your scalp. Use your comb to carefully pull some of your hair off of the tape. When you can feel the sticky, attach the top extension. Press the top and bottom wefts together firmly for about 20 seconds to make sure that they're stuck to each other.
5. Cut and Style
If you have a short blunt cut, you're going to have to do some trimming.
Styling Pro Tip:
If you have a short blunt haircut, some of your hair may stick out from underneath your bottom layer of extensions, totally giving you away. General Care for Synthetic Hair

Wearing Instruction:

1. Wash Your Hair and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section (Bottom to Top): start your first row an inch or two up from the bottom of your scalp. Use a comb to part your hair evenly. Pull the top half up and secure it, leaving the bottom half hanging down.
3. Gather a "Very" thin section of your hair. Use your comb to get a nice even section which as wide as one of your extension wefts.This section of hair is going to be sandwiched between two extensions. Make sure the adhesive "tape" on the top extension touches that of the bottom extension so that the two stick together.
4. Attach Extension: A good way to tell if your section is thin enough is attach the bottom extension in place, flush against your scalp. Use your comb to carefully pull some of your hair off of the tape. When you can feel the sticky, attach the top extension. Press the top and bottom wefts together firmly for about 20 seconds to make sure that they're stuck to each other.
5. Cut and Style: if you have a short blunt cut, you're going to have to do some trimming.

Tips to Remember
1. Use a friend.
2. Be aware of placement. Avoid putting your extensions too close to the edge of your scalp (by your face and stuff), or putting them too high up towards your part!
3. Sticky to sticky. Make sure the sticky bits from the top and bottom extension are touching each other, for maximum adherence.
Wearing Instruction
1. Wash Your Hair and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section (Bottom to Top)
Start your first row an inch or two up from the bottom of your scalp. Use a comb to part your hair evenly. Pull the top half up and secure it, leaving the bottom half hanging down. 3. Gather a *Very* Thin Section of Your Hair
Use your comb to get a nice even section which as wide as one of your extension wefts.This section of hair is going to be sandwiched between two extensions. Make sure the adhesive "tape" on the top extension touches that of the bottom extension so that the two stick together.
4. Attach Extension
Attach the bottom extension in place, flush against your scalp. Use your comb to carefully pull some of your hair off of the tape. When you can feel the sticky, attach the top extension. Press the top and bottom wefts together firmly for about 20 seconds to make sure that they're stuck to each other.
5. Cut and Style
If you have a short blunt cut, you're going to have to do some trimming.
Styling Pro Tip:
If you have a short blunt haircut, some of your hair may stick out from underneath your bottom layer of extensions, totally giving you away. Take all of these short hairs and bobby pin them to your scalp, so they won't be seen under your longest layer of extensions. If you want know more about the hair, please contact us before order.

HOW TO WASH THE HAIR EXTENSIONS

1.Comb your hair with a brush that has soft bristles or a comb with wire pin just before you wash it.This releases any tangles.It is best not to comb from top to ends one time if the hair is a curly style.
2.Wet your hair with lukewarm water.Hot water may be more comfortable,but it deteriorates the synthetic hair fibers and shortens the extensions' lifespan.Do not attempt to brush your synthetic hair extensions when they are wet.
3.Lather the hair and extensions with a mild shampoo without a bunch of unpronounceable chemicals as ingredients.All-natural is best.
4.Rinse the shampoo out of hair extensions.Use a hair conditioner that is very oily,like a deep conditioning treatment.Rinse off 90% but leave just a little in,to prevent tangling.
5.Towel-dry your hair as best you can and then allow nature to finish the process.Do not blow dry,this will cause a lot of useless tangles that will ruin your extensions.

HOW TO APPLY THE HAIR EXTENSIONS

1.Comb or brush your hair thoroughly. Gather your hair together with an elastic band. 2.Use gel or spray to control wispy "flyaways".
3.Position the ponytail so that one clip or comb attachment is above, and the other is beneath, the elastic that holds your own hair in place.
4.Gently push the comb attachments into place behind the elastic band that holds your hair. If a drawstring is attached, pull the drawstring until the ponytail extension cinches snugly against your head.

Micro loop hair extensions are a type of hair extension attached by threading sections of natural hair through small loops to hold each extension securely in place. They are also known as micro ring hair extensions.

How to Apply
1. Wash and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section off your hair about an inch from the nape of your neck.
3. Take a strand of your own hair, place it through the loop, and pull the bottom of the loop which lies under the bead.
4. Clamp the rings shut with pliars. ( You have to clamped them tight enough to avoid them slide out. )
5. Leave another fingers width between each extension. With each new layer, you'll be building up the extensions.

How to Properly Maintain and Care for Micro-Ring Hair Extensions？
1. Avoid Swimming Pools
2. Brush Your Hair on a Regular Basis
3. Tie Your Hair Back While You Sleep

description:
Tips to Remember 1. Use a friend. 
2. Be aware of placement.  Avoid putting your extensions too close to the edge of your scalp (by your face and stuff), or putting them too high up towards your part!
3. Sticky to sticky. Make sure the sticky bits from the top and bottom extension are touching each other, for maximum adherence.

Wearing Instruction
1. Wash Your Hair and dry your hair completely before starting.
2. Section (Bottom to Top)
Start your first row an inch or two up from the bottom of your scalp. Use a comb to part your hair evenly. Pull the top half up and secure it, leaving the bottom half hanging down.
3. Gather a *Very* Thin Section of Your Hair
Use your comb to get a nice even section which as wide as one of your extension wefts.This section of hair is going to be sandwiched between two extensions. Make sure the adhesive "tape" on the top extension touches that of the bottom extension so that the two stick together.
4. Attach Extension
A good way to tell if your section is thin enough is attach the bottom extension in place, flush against your scalp. Use your comb to carefully pull some of your hair off of the tape. When you can feel the sticky, attach the top extension. Press the top and bottom wefts together firmly for about 20 seconds to make sure that they're stuck to each other.
5. Cut and Style
If you have a short blunt cut, you're going to have to do some trimming.
